ac_results.ac: Every performance number is tagged (target) or cites a measurement URL.
ac_results.note: The verifier's numbers check passes. A manual check of tables, code blocks and both Mermaid labels (Figure 2 now reads '5% p99 (target), 3% alloc/op (target)') found no untagged figure.

ac_results.ac: Per-stage latency budget gives a microsecond budget per Filter Chain stage in a table.
ac_results.note: The table covers every Phase from onRequestHeaders to onLog, plus onChunk, with p50 and p99 in µs. The sums check out: S2 is 92 + 58 = 150 at p50 and 285 + 715 = 1,000 at p99; S1 is 45 at p50 and 177 at p99.

ac_results.ac: Throughput and resources per core states the reference hardware.
ac_results.note: The Reference hardware subsection defines RH-1 (bare-metal amd64, fixed 3.0 GHz, SMT off, 4-core cpuset, GOMAXPROCS=4) and the RH-1L, RH-1U, RH-1S, RH-2 and RH-3 hosts.

ac_results.ac: Benchmark methodology names the load tool, protocol, duration, percentiles and reference machine, and addresses open-loop load, coordinated omission, warm-up and reproducibility.
ac_results.note: Tools: oha, vegeta and fortio. Protocol per scenario. Duration: five runs of 180 s. Percentiles: p50 to maximum from HdrHistogram. Machine: RH-1. Open-loop and coordinated-omission, warm-up and reproducibility subsections are present, with citations.

ac_results.ac: Benchmark suite and CI gating quantifies the regression policy (more than 5% p99 latency or more than 3% alloc/op regression fails, tagged (target)).
ac_results.note: L480 and the gate table both tag the thresholds (target), and Figure 2 now tags them too.

ac_results.ac: Benchmark methodology includes a competitor baseline plan against KrakenD CE, Envoy, APISIX and Kong.
ac_results.note: The Competitor baseline plan table covers all four with versions, S1, S2 and S5 equivalents and research-backed URLs. JWT parity is deferred to OQ-7.

ac_results.ac: Budgets tie to the SLOs defined in docs/architecture/10-observability.md.
ac_results.note: The Budget catalog maps every PB to SLO-GW-1 to SLO-GW-7, SLO-CP-1, 'Related' or 'None'. SLI metric names and bucket thresholds match Observability's SLO definitions.

ac_results.ac: The seed targets appear, each tagged (target): p99 added latency 1 ms or less for plain proxying at 10k rps per core; at least 50k rps on 4 vCPU; WASM Plugin call 50 microseconds or less; RSS 100 MB or less plus about 2 KB per Route; hot reload of 5,000 Routes in 500 ms or less.
ac_results.note: The Seed targets table and PB-1, PB-4, PB-5, PB-6 and PB-7 carry all five, each tagged (target).

ac_results.ac: Profiling playbook covers pprof, GOGC and GOMEMLIMIT.
ac_results.note: The playbook covers pprof capture on 9901 with TB-9 authentication, and has a GOGC and GOMEMLIMIT subsection with gc-guide citations and Ruralz rules.
